root_idea.summary: The root expresses aversion, repulsiveness, and what is unpleasant or distasteful.
root_idea.development: Its concrete reference to the unpleasant fluid of a camel's stomach is connected lexically with the figurative description of a person as rough, coarse, or repellent in character.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized citation form فَظّ, which is the Quran-attested descriptive nominal.

senses.definition: Rough, coarse, rude, or repellent in character and manner.
senses.usage_conditions: Applied to a person, including harshness of conduct or speech. In the Quranic expression فَظًّا غَلِيظَ الْقَلْبِ, it describes an unpleasant and harsh disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become rough, coarse, rude, or difficult in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; its associated verbal nouns include فَظَاظَةٌ and فَظَظٌ, with فَظَاظَةٌ reported as the more common form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To let out, press out, or squeeze out the fluid from a camel's stomach, and to drink the extracted fluid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the treatment of a camel's stomach fluid, including extraction after slaughter or by opening the stomach in conditions of thirst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The coarse, bitter fluid of a camel's stomach, pressed out and drunk as an emergency beverage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Associated with thirst or travel in waterless desert regions; it was reported not to be usable for ritual purification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Horse urine used as a drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in the context of drinking it when suffering from thirst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn someone back or away from the object of his desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV construction with a person as the one turned away and the desired object as the point from which he is diverted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To insert a thread into the eye of a needle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction concerning threading a needle; the attached pronoun may refer to the eye of the needle or to the thread, according to the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seminal fluid, reported especially as that of a woman or a stallion; one account specifies the stallion's fluid in a she-camel's womb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The identification is reported with differing attributions and is not considered firmly established; a connection with camel-stomach fluid is also transmitted but disputed.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The Form I state of being or becoming rough is represented.
The extraction and drinking construction is represented.
The specialized sense of turning someone away from a desired object is represented.
The descriptive adjective meaning is Quran-attested and represented.
Both the camel-stomach fluid and horse-urine drink usages are represented.
The rare and disputed seminal-fluid meaning is represented with its reported uncertainty.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the preceding discussion.
Comparative and synonymic restatement of the adjective, with no independent lexical branch.

cautions: The rare noun فَظِيظٌ has conflicting transmitted explanations, so its seminal-fluid sense is presented as reported rather than certain.
